item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Fundraisers support St. Pete Ceramics after fire destroyed studio earlier this year
item.description: The Werk Gallery is hosting a fundraising exhibit for St. Pete Ceramics. The clay studio burnt down earlier this year in January.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Contiguous US breaks its record for hottest month ever, NOAA says
item.description: The contiguous United States sizzled to its hottest month ever last month, according to the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Spring Hill kidnapping ends in murder-suicide involving off-duty deputy: PSO
item.description: A reported kidnapping in Hudson ended with an off-duty Pinellas County deputy and a woman found dead from gunshot wounds in Spring Hill, authorities said.

item.title: [BREAKING] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Woman dies and man injured in shooting in Seminole: PCSO
item.description: Pinellas County Sheriff's Office (PCSO) said a woman has died and a man is injured after a shooting in Seminole.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Vindman’s money advantage meets Nixon’s Florida roots in Democratic Senate primary
item.description: Republican Sen. Ashley Moody remains favored in the special election, but Democrats must first choose between two sharply different candidates.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Murder-suicide stemming from kidnapping under investigation in Spring Hill: Deputies
item.description: A murder-suicide that stems from a kidnapping is under investigation in Spring Hill, according to the Pasco Sheriff's Office.
